role: independent reference frames, exported through After Effects Render Queue
independence: Frames come from AE's Render Queue through aerender.exe, not through the adapter's checkout path. The GrapiX adapter is resident in the render process because it lives in the Plug-ins folder, but it issues no command during an export and contributes no pixels.
comparableUnit: pixelSha256 — the decoded strip payload. Never fileSha256: After Effects embeds per-render XMP metadata, so three renders of one unchanged frame produced three different file digests over byte-identical pixels. A file digest would report a pixel defect that does not exist.
